lines.text: The elder writes to Gaius, prays for his health, and has no greater joy than hearing his children walk in the truth.
The elder calls Gaius faithful toward the brothers, who are strangers to him, and who testified to the church about his love.
The brothers went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Samaritans, so we ought to support them.
Diotrephes, who loves to be first, refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids others, putting them out of the church.
The elder says Demetrius has a good testimony from everyone and hopes to see Gaius soon, face to face, rather than use scrolls.
